result.topic_en: Title page of Euler's prize essay on the physical cause of the ebb and flow of the sea (the tides), with his name, affiliation and a Latin verse motto.
result.transcription:
INQUISITIO PHYSICA
IN CAUSAM
FLUXUS AC REFLUXUS
MARIS.
A. D. D. EULER; Mathematicarum Professore, è Societate
Academiæ Imperialis Sancti-Petersburgensis.

Cur nunc declivi nudentur littora Ponto;
Adversis tumeat nunc Maris unda fretis;
Dum vestro monitu naturam consulo rerum:
Quàm procul à Terris abdita caussa latet!
In Solem Lunamque feror. Si plauditis ausô;
Sidera sublimi vertice summa petam.

items.quote:
Cur nunc declivi nudentur littora Ponto;
Adversis tumeat nunc Maris unda fretis;
items.english: Why are the shores now laid bare as the sea slopes away, and why does the wave of the sea now swell in the opposing straits?
